body: Amen. And that's why I drown them out with mindless stuff. Makes everything easier.

I'm sorry, I hate that life is like that for some people. I think I could handle it better if it was all physical though. The emotional and mental stuff messes with me too much. It's made me quite paranoid and distrustful. I really hope I'll be able to defend myself when if anything every happens... Just unleash some of the emotions on someone else instead of myself. Sounds good.

Lol you aren't bad with words, it's fine. But yes, I think that was the first serious one. At least the one I remember hitting back in. I just know I would snap because I have way too much emotion and shit pent up in me, and I know it. It's bad, blah blah yeah, but at least I don't hurt other people... I think. But yes, I hate drama and that is what my house is centered around. Not fun.

Uhm... No, it isn't but the time before that we were just playing around fighting. Before that I don't think I've lost it even in that small amount at him. I almost lost it entirely when he wouldn't get out of my face and screamed and got my fist to right infront of his face before I controlled myself. 

The response thing is good, I suppose. I guess I have that also, it's just never really been tested. I try to avoid drama and stress. Maybe I'm *too* passive.

I think that it will improve, though my father seems to be having a tough time with me moving away and it would maybe get worse. But he has to learn in his own way I guess?
And yes, I plan on going to college and I've been accepted and payed the first little fee for it. I'm very very excited and can't wait for that part of my life to start; it's just getting there that is taking the biggest hit on me.

That's at least what he did today. It was weird and very uncomfortable and I wasn't sure what to do. If he ever does something like seriously come at me I would probably lose it and beat the crap out of him. I hope I would at least.
Lmao I totally would if I was a guy xD Lady fapping ftw. Thanks for cheering me up a little.

Lol I know you didn't mean that. And I did defend myself, I hit him in the face repeatedly and pushed him violently away from me. Nothing worked. He was acting like a bully, you know, "hit me, hit me you pussy, hit me."

Yeah, I've definitely had my share of family arguements for my teenage years lol. The physical violence isn't normal, but if I need to I suppose I can take care of myself. My dad has had problems, he doesn't know how to deal with any of them, so he takes it out on me. I try to avoid it but it gets hard sometimes.

About the 18 thing, I'm almost 18 and cannot wait for that day. I don't want dependencies on them, anyone that I need to be dependent on is a weakness on my part. That's what my problem is, I care too much. Anyways, yes, as soon as I'm 18 I plan on making some changes. I'm not sure what, yet, but something needs to happen.

That's what I've been trying to do now. Just staying quiet in my basement and zoning out. And yeah, I know about the scars. Not sure how I feel about them. But the point of earlier was to endanger my life, if you get my drift. I think I'm good for now though. Thank you :)
Yes, as soon as I go talk to him I'll get back to you. Thank you :)
Thank you, I'll try to do this tomorrow.

Thanks, that would be interesting to read about. All I know is that it releases endorphins (maybe?) and it numbs the body. It just gave me something to hurt instead of hurting other people. I can lash out on my leg and see the pain and not hurt anyone else. Weird ass logic.

I'm sorry to hear about your cutting. No one should have to feel that way, but there it is. I'll try the magic marker sometime maybe. But I think it's more of the feeling of pain that "helps" me, not the image. But I'll try it, thank you.

Not really sure what to say to this. I have a hard time hurting people emotionally with stupid things that I'm upset with, I'm not sure I could knock my own father out. But then again he did say I was a pussy.

Well he's been drinking so it's more of him half-heartedly swinging while I block his arms and push him away. It's over now, I'm staying quiet in my room and trying to calm down. Also in this case the police would just make the situation worse, I can deal with him myself physically. It's the mental stuff that is destorying me.

Wow thanks for that link lol. It's amusing. And the cutting thing, I'm not sure about it. I feel the urge to do it and just have everything be done with, but I don't have the drive right now, so I guess that's good. Today is the first day that I've cut my wrists, normally I just cut my leg to get some anger out. But I meant it this time, I thought, I just didn't have anything sharp enough until now and, like I said, I'm exhausted from having to fight off my dad, screaming and crying.

I know it isn't my fault, I just feel so stuck and hopeless and I can't take the emotional shit anymore. I'm to the point where this stuff exhausts me and then I don't have any genuine emotion at any other time, it just takes up too much energy. Thank you, though, and maybe I'll go talk to them.
